item.title: NSU Middle Lab Orchestra students qualify for All-State
item.description: The N.S.U. Middle Lab Orchestra has announced that 12 of its students have qualified for the Louisiana Music Educators Association All-State Middle School Orchestra. The students earned their selections through a competitive statewide audition process. item.title: PODCAST: with Billy Joe Harrington and Ed Colbert
item.description: Join Marvin as he chats with DA Billy Joe Harrington and Ed Colbert regarding Pre-trial diversion. An alternative to traditional prosecution that allows eligible defendants to avoid a criminal conviction by completing a structured program.
